text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking down the hallway when suddenly Agnes Tachyon calls out to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, take a look at that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Can you see? At the end of the hallway… near the landing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I squint my eyes to see a bit better…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Kehe… Keeheehee…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All my adorable Umas bustling up and down the stairway!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Are those wings? Is that an angel? A real angel? It is an angel!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you see now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, we're roommates. And she's quite the intriguing person, to say the least.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: For instance, she apparently enjoys observing other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: She notices even the slightest anomalies that I am likely to overlook!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: She'll mention things like, "Her step is shorter than yesterday," or, "Her footsteps sound different than usual!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Can you believe her observational skills?! She's remarkable!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer! You must convince her to work together with me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whenever I—no, whenever an Umamusume approaches her to talk, she tends to grow tense.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But if you're there, it might ease that tension. Please, you must help me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp?! They just held hands! And the way they kept looking away and being all shy? Epic!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Look at the way their hands intertwined… They totally touched fingertips, didn't they?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohmigosh! Is this heaven?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wowie! Super maximum excitement overload! I can't even!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyawahhh?! Tachyon's trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And Tachyon, too! In the flesh! Ahhh, you're as beautiful as you were this morning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you have a moment? You see, I was hoping—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's amazing enough just sharing a room together, but now you're here approaching me outside!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uhhahabls! I'm so happy, I might be having a heart attack! Huff… puff… Wait a sec! I need some time to prepare!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on! I haven't said what I…
choice_data_list: Oh, looks like she's dropped her treasured Umamusume scrapbook!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on! I haven't said what I…
choice_data_list: Oh, looks like she's dropped her treasured Umamusume scrapbook!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, intriguing! So you like a challenge, do you, Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I will learn about those extraordinarily observant eyes of yours!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon and I chase around the overexcited Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I won't let you escape, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uwaaao! Your rising tone and the way your ears twitched when you said "escape!" This is love! I'm in wuv!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We chase her for over an hour… Eventually, we lose sight of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though she was unable to make her request, Agnes Tachyon seems to have learned something from all the chasing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?! Where is it?! Where is it?! Where's my beloved Umamusume scrapbook?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Nice, Trainer! If we keep this up, we'll eventually capture her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hroooaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon grabs Agnes Digital from behind in a full nelson.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah?! Is this the warm embrace of one of my precious Umas?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What the… Her body temperature has rapidly increased!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital helplessly collapses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, we didn't manage to ask for her help, but it seems like Agnes Tachyon was able to learn something through the exchange.
